definition: requests per second returning 2xx with TTLT <= slo_ttlt_ms; 429 and 503 count as offered-and-failed with zero useful completion, never as zero-latency samples
basis: p95 TTLT of stock FCFS in the saturated round-A run, rounded to 100 ms. Chosen because it is the latency a user already absorbs with no optimisation in place, and because it is fixed from data collected before any overload arm ran.
frozen_before: the overload arm (C') and any 15 ms contract arm (B)
